title: Bit Unpacking
text: Bit Unpacking 模块提取数据帧；按 {Input port (packed) data types} 指定紧凑数据类型；{Bit Patterns} 指定位模式、{Input port (packed) dimension} 指定压缩数据维度、{Output port (unpacked) data types (cell array)} 指定未封装的数据类型、{Output port (unpacked) dimension (cell array)} 指定未打包数据维度、{Sign extend} 启用符号扩展，按实例取值。

params.name: Input port (packed) data types
params.values: 紧凑数据类型 uint32 (默认) | double | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | boolean

params.name: Output port (unpacked) data types (cell array)
params.values: 未封装的数据类型 {’uint32’} (默认)

params.name: Sign extend
params.values: 启用符号扩展 on (默认) | off
